rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The Chief Cabinet Secretary's press record of the morning of 13 September 2007, headed 安倍内閣総理大臣の検診について, says that 安倍総理, being unwell, had gone to a hospital in Tokyo for an examination at about 10:45 and was being examined; the results were not yet known.
